summary.text: Luke Evslin represents District 16 in the Hawaii House of Representatives and took office on February 21, 2023; he is running for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: He lives in Lihu'e, graduated from Kaua'i High School in 2003, earned a B.A. in history from the University of Hawai'i at Manoa in 2007 and an M.P.A. from the University of Southern California in 2020.
His career includes co-founding Kamanu Composites, teaching American government and Hawaiian history at Island School, and writing as a columnist for the Honolulu Civil Beat.
